shots.name: T12_city_fight
shots.setup: (() => { const h = G.hero, R = G.world.metro.plan.ring; G.filmCam = null; if (window.__d && G.ember.champions().endDuel) G.ember.champions().endDuel(); if (G.sky.setHour) G.sky.setHour(0.45); G.ember.setSide('water', { place: false, quiet: true }); G.enemies.clearAll && G.enemies.clearAll(); Q.walkAt(R.x + 3, R.y); h.pos.y = 7 + 1.5 + 0.92; h.inv = 1e6; h.hp = h.maxHp; const f = G.ember.raidNow(2) || []; f.forEach((e, i) => { e.pos.set(h.pos.x + 6 - i * 12, h.pos.y + 2, h.pos.z + 5); e.vel.set(0, 0, 0); e.state = 'circle'; e.t = 0.4; }); window.__f = f; G.camYaw = -2.4; G.camPitch = 0.16; window.__n = 0; return 'ok'; })()
shots.each: window.__n++; const n = window.__n, h = G.hero; h.inv = 1e6; h.hp = h.maxHp; (window.__f || []).forEach((e) => { if (e.hp < 80) e.hp = 300; }); const w = { mx: 0, my: 0 }; const PP = { 8: 'atk', 22: 'atk', 36: 'atk', 60: 'spin', 95: 'atk', 109: 'atk', 123: 'wave' }; if (PP[n]) w[PP[n]] = true; Q.drive(w);

shots.name: T13_city_fly
